paragraphs.text: q.d., Thou hast not long to do; up therefore and be doing; work while it is yet day; the night of death cometh, when none can work. Divide what thou hast conquered, yea, that which is yet to be conquered, among the tribes; for all is theirs, unless they forget their charter. See the true Christian’s charter, which he cannot forfeit. {1Co 3:22-23}
paragraphs.anchor: Thou art old and stricken in years

paragraphs.text: Anciently called Caphtorims. {Deu 2:23 Amo 9:7} Their country lay along the coast of the midland sea; whereby the Israelites were kept from much trading with other nations, that they might not learn their manners. Hence Judea is called an "isle," though part of the continent. {Isa 20:6} Like Benjamin, who had his mess by himself.
paragraphs.anchor: All the borders of the Philistines.

paragraphs.text: Or Nile, which hath its name Sihor from blackness, and Nile from muddiness. So much of Egypt as this river watereth, is a black mould, so fruitful, as they do but throw in the seed, and have four rich harvests in less than four months, as travellers tell us.
paragraphs.anchor: From Sihor.

paragraphs.text: Who, belike, still held part of their old possession. {Deu 2:22-23}
paragraphs.anchor: Also the Avites.

paragraphs.text: Who yet held out against the Israelites, but hindered them not from dividing the land. No more shall those remnants of corruption hinder the saints from possession of their mansions prepared for them by Christ. {Joh 14:2}
paragraphs.anchor: All the land of the Canaanites.

paragraphs.text: Called Gebal in Psa 83:7 Eze 27:9. Enemies to the Church.
paragraphs.anchor: And the land of the Giblites.

paragraphs.text: viz., If the Israelites rule with me and be faithful with my saints, as Hos 11:12; else "they shall know my breach of promise," as Num 14:34.
paragraphs.anchor: Them will I drive out, &c.

paragraphs.text: Even those parts thereof also that are yet unsubdued; for it is theirs, but so as they must win it before they wear it. Sic petitur caelum. The kingdom of heaven suffereth violence.
paragraphs.anchor: Now therefore divide this land.

paragraphs.text: So do thou confirm it. Here then is no tautology, as at first it may seem to be.

paragraphs.anchor: And the city that is in the midst.

paragraphs.text: Places of much idolatry, that land desolating sin: such as are now Sichem and Loretto; where, whensoever the Ave Maria bell rings, which is at sunrising, noon, and sun setting, all men, in what place soever, house, field, street, or market, do presently kneel down and say an Ave Maria, &c.
paragraphs.anchor: Bamothbaal and Bethbaalmeon.

paragraphs.text: The cities and coasts of each tribe are thus particularly set down, to prevent discord and division, that mother of dissolution.
His vassals; and after his death they made themselves kings, but were shortly after slain by the sword of Israel. {Num 31:8}
paragraphs.anchor: Dukes of Sihon.

paragraphs.text: The spellman of Satan: though by his words he might seem a friend to Israel, yet was he worthily cut off by them for his wicked counsel. So shall all such perish as "turn aside, like Balaam, unto their crooked ways: but peace shall be upon Israel." {Psa 125:5} See Jdg 1:11.
